name: a position at the origin, and none
a: charge disc a { radius 1; at fly=0 hoist=0; }

name: two positions, and only one
a: charge disc a { radius 1; at center; at fly=0 hoist=0; }
b: charge disc a { radius 1; at fly=0 hoist=0; }

name: an apex at the start, and none
a: chevrons a { depth 1; angle 45; apex 0; }

name: no opacity, and full
a: field a { opacity 0; }

name: a split at the origin, and none
a: quarters a b a b { split fly=0 hoist=0; }

name: an emblem at the origin, and none
a: emblem { at fly=0 hoist=0; charge disc a { radius 1; }; }

name: a panel at the origin, and none
a: panel { at fly=0 hoist=0; fly 1; hoist 1; field a; }

name: rays from the origin, and the center
a: rays a b { from fly=0 hoist=0; }

name: a ring's arc from up, and no arc
a: charge ring a { radius 2; inner 1; from 0; to 90; }

name: an arc ending at up, and at another place
a: charge ring a { radius 2; inner 1; from 90; to 0; }
b: charge ring a { radius 2; inner 1; from 90; to 10; }

name: a bar that doesn't grow, and one that does
a: bars a b { grow 0 1; }

name: a grow of evens, and none
a: bars a b { grow 1 1; }

name: a stop at the start, and elsewhere
a point at the origin, and elsewhere
a: charge polygon a { point fly=0 hoist=0; point fly=1 hoist=0; point fly=1 hoist=1; }
b: charge polygon a { point fly=0 hoist=1; point fly=1 hoist=0; point fly=1 hoist=1; }

name: a line stepping only one way, and the other
a: charge disc a { radius 1; repeat line count=2 fly=1; }
b: charge disc a { radius 1; repeat line count=2 hoist=1; }

name: an arc's start at up, and elsewhere
a: charge disc a { radius 1; repeat arc count=2 radius=1 from=0 to=90; }
b: charge disc a { radius 1; repeat arc count=2 radius=1 from=1 to=90; }

name: a box at the origin, and elsewhere
a: charge path a { d "M0 0Z"; box "0 0 1 1"; fly 1; }
b: charge path a { d "M0 0Z"; box "1 0 1 1"; fly 1; }

name: a box's fly, and hoist
a: charge path a { d "M0 0Z"; box "0 0 1 1"; fly 1; }
b: charge path a { d "M0 0Z"; box "0 0 1 1"; hoist 1; }

name: a cross's fly, and hoist
a: cross a { fly 0 1 1; hoist 1 1 0; }

name: a pile's base at the start
a: pile a { depth 1; base 0 1; }

name: a pile's tip at the start
a: pile a { tip 0 1; }

name: a pile's edge
a: pile a { depth 1; from top; }

name: a pile's flat
a: pile a { depth 1; flat 1; }

name: a pall's junction
a: pall a { width 1; junction 1; }

name: a pile, and a pall
a: pile a { depth 1; }

name: a canton, and a panel in another corner
a: canton { fly 1; hoist 1; field a; }
b: panel { corner upper-fly; fly 1; hoist 1; field a; }

name: edge and angle measures
a: rays a b { measure edge; }

name: evenodd
a: charge path a { d "M0 0Z"; box "0 0 1 1"; fly 1; evenodd; }
b: charge path a { d "M0 0Z"; box "0 0 1 1"; fly 1; }

name: a hollow shape
a: charge disc a { radius 1; hollow 0.5; }

name: a star's lines
a: charge star a { radius 1; lines 0.5; }

name: a star's points
a: charge star a { radius 1; points 6; }

name: a star's inner
a: charge star a { radius 1; inner 0.1; }

name: a sun's gap
a: charge sun a { radius 2; disc 1; gap 0.1; }

name: a sun's spread
a: charge sun a { radius 2; disc 1; spread 0.5; }

name: a turn
a: charge disc a { radius 1; repeat ring count=2 radius=1 turn=#true; }
b: charge disc a { radius 1; repeat ring count=2 radius=1; }

name: a stagger
a: charge disc a { radius 1; repeat grid rows=2 columns=2 stagger=#true; }
b: charge disc a { radius 1; repeat grid rows=2 columns=2; }

name: rotations
a: band a { width 1; rotate 1; }

name: offsets
a: band a { width 1; offset 1; }

name: axes
a: band a { width 1; along hoist; }

name: blends
a: field a { blend multiply; }

name: anchors
a: charge disc a { radius 1; anchor end; }

name: clips
a: field a { clip { disc { radius 1; }; }; }

name: a pile as a clip, and a pall
a: field a { clip { pile { depth 1; }; }; }

name: cuts
a: field a { cut { disc { radius 1; }; }; }

name: diagonal quarters
a: quarters a b a b { diagonal; }

name: a counterchange
a: saltire a { width 1; counterchange; }

name: a check's flow
a: checks a b { rows 2; columns 2; flow bend; }

name: what a definition holds
a:
define d { field a; }
use d
b:
define d { field b; }
use d

name: a definition's grid
a:
define d hoist=1 fly=1 { field a; }
use d
b:
define d { field a; }
use d

name: a reverse
a:
field a
reverse { field b; }

name: an outside border
a:
border a 1 outside
field a

name: wider and narrower
a:
field a
adapt { wider extend; }

name: a range
a:
field a
adapt { wider extend; range 1 2; }

name: a variant turning
a:
field a
variant v { from rotate; }
b:
field a
variant v { from transpose; }

name: a variant turned upside down or all the way around
a:
field a
variant v { from half-turn; }
b:
field a
variant v { from invert; }

name: a variant upright
a:
field a
variant v { from rotate; upright; }
b:
field a
variant v { from rotate; }

name: a variant's outside border
a:
field a
variant v { border a 1 outside; }
b:
field a
variant v { border a 1; }

name: a fold's crease
a:
field a
fold f { over along=hoist at=5 move=fly; }
b:
field a
fold f { over along=hoist at=5 move=hoist; }

name: a fold's direction
a:
field a
fold f { over along=hoist at=5 move=fly; }
b:
field a
fold f { under along=hoist at=5 move=fly; }

name: a fold through any line
a:
field a
fold f { over through="0 0 1 1" move="0 1"; }
b:
field a
fold f { over through="0 0 1 1" move="1 0"; }
